nodes.name: links.rs
nodes.summary: Manages guitar string links and fret relationships for tab rendering, providing utilities to resolve which strings and frets are involved in chord shapes and single-note passages.

nodes.name: main.rs
nodes.summary: Core application entry point for OxiGuitar's GUI, orchestrating the Slint UI, plugin system, audio playback, engraving worker, track management, and the main event loop that connects all subsystems together.

nodes.name: manager.rs
nodes.summary: Manages the application's state and component lifecycle, coordinating between the UI layer, audio subsystem, and plugin system to maintain consistent application behavior.

nodes.name: palette.rs
nodes.summary: Color palette management for the application, defining color schemes for light and dark themes, managing UI color assignments, and providing theme-aware color resolution for the Slint interface.

nodes.name: player.rs
nodes.summary: Audio playback engine that handles song playback, note timing, cursor positioning, and synchronization between the audio output and the visual score display during playback.

nodes.name: playing.rs
nodes.summary: Manages the playing state machine, tracking playback position, handling play/pause/stop transitions, and coordinating cursor movement with audio timing during song playback.

nodes.name: plugin_tabs.rs
nodes.summary: Plugin tab management providing a dedicated thread that handles plugin tab rendering, event processing, canvas drawing, and settings windows, keeping plugin operations off the UI thread for responsiveness.

nodes.name: prefs.rs
nodes.summary: Application preferences management, handling user configuration storage, loading, and persistence for settings like tempo, display options, and plugin preferences.

nodes.name: shell.rs
nodes.summary: Shell window management handling tab areas, side panels, active tab tracking, and the main window layout structure that organizes the application's visual components.

nodes.name: song.rs
nodes.summary: Song data structure and utilities, representing a musical piece with its tracks, tempo, time signature, and metadata for the tablature editor.

nodes.name: sound.rs
nodes.summary: Sound generation and audio processing utilities, handling note synthesis, audio buffer management, and the conversion of musical data into playable audio output.

nodes.name: speed.rs
nodes.summary: Tempo and speed control for playback, managing BPM changes, tempo curves, and the conversion between musical time and playback position.

nodes.name: test_support.rs
nodes.summary: Test utilities and helpers for the application, providing mock plugins, test fixtures, and shared test infrastructure for unit testing the GUI components.

nodes.name: track_form.rs
nodes.summary: Track form UI component for editing track properties, handling instrument selection, tuning configuration, and track metadata in the tablature editor interface.

nodes.name: track_sections.rs
nodes.summary: Track section management for organizing songs into sections like verses, choruses, and bridges, providing section navigation and structural editing capabilities.

nodes.name: tracks.rs
nodes.summary: Track management system handling track creation, deletion, reordering, and the lifecycle of individual tracks within a song, including their notes and metadata.

nodes.name: worker.rs
nodes.summary: Engraving worker that handles the rendering and layout of musical notation, processing song data into visual representations with proper spacing, alignment, and page breaks.

nodes.name: app.slint
nodes.summary: Main Slint UI definition for OxiGuitar's graphical interface, defining the window layout, menu bars, toolbars, track list, score display area, and all interactive UI elements.

nodes.name: bar_dialog.slint
nodes.summary: Slint UI definition for the bar editing dialog, providing controls for bar properties, note editing, and bar-level operations within the tablature editor.

nodes.name: plugin_manager.slint
nodes.summary: Slint UI definition for the plugin manager interface, allowing users to browse, enable, disable, and configure installed plugins.

nodes.name: plugin_tab.slint
nodes.summary: Slint UI definition for individual plugin tabs displayed within the main window, rendering plugin-provided content and handling user interactions.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: CPAL-based audio backend library providing audio device enumeration, stream creation, and sample-level audio output for OxiGuitar's playback system.

nodes.name: convert.rs
nodes.summary: Command-line utility for converting OxiGuitar song files between formats, handling file I/O, format detection, and batch conversion operations.

nodes.name: Cargo.toml
nodes.summary: Rust package manifest for the oxiguitar-audio-cpal crate, defining CPAL-based audio backend dependencies, features, and build configuration.

nodes.name: Cargo.toml
nodes.summary: Rust package manifest for the oxiguitar-cli crate, defining CLI tool dependencies, binary targets, and build configuration for the command-line interface.

nodes.name: shell_id
nodes.summary: Converts a plugin TabId into a shell-compatible string identifier in the format plugin:{plugin}/{tab}.

nodes.name: tab_of
nodes.summary: Parses a shell string identifier back into a TabId, extracting the plugin name and tab name from the plugin:{plugin}/{tab} format.

nodes.name: side_of
nodes.summary: Maps a plugin's Area enum variant (Top, Bottom, Left, Right) to the corresponding Shell Side enum variant.

nodes.name: add_to
nodes.summary: Registers all plugin tabs declared in manifests to their respective window areas, adding them after core tabs in plugin order without loading plugins.

nodes.name: remove_from
nodes.summary: Removes all tabs belonging to a withdrawn plugin from every window area, simulating the plugin never having been installed.

nodes.name: theme
nodes.summary: Creates a Theme with appropriate page colors for dark or light interface mode, using predefined theme constants as the base.

nodes.name: fitted
nodes.summary: Calculates the pixel dimensions for drawing a canvas to fill available room while maintaining proportions, bounded by MAX_CANVAS_PIXELS.

nodes.name: draw
nodes.summary: Renders a canvas widget from tab content into a premultiplied RGBA pixmap using the rasterizer, applying theme colors and font rendering.

nodes.name: merge
nodes.summary: Merges duplicate or superseded requests in a batch: replaces consecutive drags on the same widget with the latest, removes stale size requests, and deduplicates content requests.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Main event loop for the plugin tab thread, processing requests from the channel, batching them, merging duplicates, and dispatching to appropriate handlers.

nodes.name: answered
nodes.summary: Processes a plugin's tab content response, drawing canvases at their current room sizes and sending the Answer back through the sink callback.

nodes.name: settings_window
nodes.summary: Retrieves the settings window content for a plugin by ID, optionally processing a widget event, and validates it contains no canvases.

nodes.name: track_section
nodes.summary: Retrieves a plugin's track section for a given track, optionally processing a widget event, and validates it contains no canvases.

nodes.name: Request
nodes.summary: Enum representing the window's requests to the plugin tab thread: content fetch, pointer events, canvas sizing, theme changes, settings windows, and track sections.

nodes.name: Answer
nodes.summary: Enum representing the tab thread's responses to the window: tab content with canvases, individual canvas redraws, settings window content, and track section content.

nodes.name: Drawn
nodes.summary: Data structure holding a rendered canvas's widget name, dimensions, and premultiplied RGBA pixel data.

nodes.name: TabThread
nodes.summary: Manages the plugin tab thread lifecycle: starting the thread with plugins and dark mode setting, sending requests via channel, and joining on drop.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: Initializes the CPAL audio backend, enumerating available audio devices and preparing the stream configuration.

nodes.name: play
nodes.summary: Starts audio playback by creating and launching a CPAL audio stream with the configured callback.

nodes.name: convert
nodes.summary: Converts an OxiGuitar song file from one format to another, handling format detection and data transformation.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Entry point for the CLI convert command, parsing arguments and delegating to the convert function.

nodes.name: App
nodes.summary: Core application state struct holding the Slint AppWindow reference, shared state, plugin system, and all subsystem handles for the main GUI window.

nodes.name: Asked
nodes.summary: Enum representing the window's questions to the plugin tab thread: content fetch, pointer events, canvas sizing, theme changes, settings windows, and track sections.

nodes.name: Then
nodes.summary: Enum representing the actions to take after a plugin tab thread response is received: update content, redraw canvas, update settings, update track section.

nodes.name: PluginTabState
nodes.summary: Holds the state for a single plugin tab: its TabId, current content, canvas mappings, and pending operations.

nodes.name: PluginView
nodes.summary: Wraps a Slint component for a plugin tab, managing its lifecycle and rendering within the shell area.

nodes.name: WindowCore
nodes.summary: Core window state shared between the main thread and plugin tab thread, containing the shared application state and plugin tab channel.

nodes.name: State
nodes.summary: Engraving worker state holding the current score, track shapes, caret position, and all data needed for score rendering and layout.

nodes.name: Asked
nodes.summary: Request struct sent to the player engine: score data, revision number, and whether the score is fresh (never seen before).

nodes.name: Times
nodes.summary: Tracks timing data for the speed test: receiver for events, start time, and elapsed duration measurements.

nodes.name: Keeper
nodes.summary: RAII guard that keeps an audio device stream open, implementing Drop to properly close the stream on cleanup.

nodes.name: Thread
nodes.summary: Sound thread state managing the audio output device, score playback, and the receiver channel for sound commands.

nodes.name: Recorder
nodes.summary: Test plugin recorder implementing oxiguitar_host::Core, capturing plugin notifications and redraw events for test verification.

nodes.name: plugin_withdrawn
nodes.summary: Removes a withdrawn plugin's tabs from the window and cleans up its state.

nodes.name: display_system
nodes.summary: Returns the display system string (x11, wayland, or headless) for the current build.

nodes.name: sync_footer
nodes.summary: Synchronizes the footer message display with the current application state.

nodes.name: sync_shell
nodes.summary: Synchronizes the shell window state with the current application data.

nodes.name: sync_toolbar
nodes.summary: Synchronizes the toolbar state with the current application data.

nodes.name: sync_areas
nodes.summary: Synchronizes the window areas (tabs, sections) with the current application data.

nodes.name: save
nodes.summary: Saves the current score to disk, optionally prompting the user if the file has changed.

nodes.name: engrave
nodes.summary: Runs the engraving process on the current score, producing the visual layout for display.

nodes.name: was
nodes.summary: Compares two slices and returns which elements have changed, used to detect track reordering.

nodes.name: changed_score
nodes.summary: Checks if the score has changed and triggers re-engraving if needed.

nodes.name: track_mix
nodes.summary: Converts a TrackMix to the player's internal mix representation.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Entry point for the OxiGuitar application, initializing the Slint UI and starting the event loop.

nodes.name: run_worker
nodes.summary: Main worker loop that processes engraving tasks and manages the rendering pipeline.

nodes.name: start
nodes.summary: Starts audio playback from the current position.

nodes.name: stop
nodes.summary: Stops audio playback and resets the playback position.

nodes.name: seek
nodes.summary: Seeks to a specific position in the song during playback.

nodes.name: area
nodes.summary: Returns a reference to a shell area by its identifier.

nodes.name: area_mut
nodes.summary: Returns a mutable reference to a shell area by its identifier.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Retrieves a color from the palette by name.

nodes.name: resolve
nodes.summary: Resolves a color from the palette, applying theme adjustments.

nodes.name: add
nodes.summary: Adds a new track to the song.

nodes.name: remove
nodes.summary: Removes a track from the song by index.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Retrieves a track by index.

nodes.name: is_playing
nodes.summary: Returns whether the song is currently playing.

nodes.name: position
nodes.summary: Returns the current playback position.

nodes.name: play_note
nodes.summary: Plays a single note on the audio output.

nodes.name: stop
nodes.summary: Stops all sound output.

nodes.name: get_bpm
nodes.summary: Returns the current BPM (beats per minute).

nodes.name: set_bpm
nodes.summary: Sets the BPM (beats per minute) for playback.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a new empty song.

nodes.name: tracks
nodes.summary: Returns a reference to the song's tracks.

nodes.name: load
nodes.summary: Loads application preferences from disk.

nodes.name: save
nodes.summary: Saves application preferences to disk.

nodes.name: render
nodes.summary: Renders the track form UI for editing track properties.

nodes.name: handle_event
nodes.summary: Handles user events on the track form.

nodes.name: sections
nodes.summary: Returns the song sections for a track.

nodes.name: add_section
nodes.summary: Adds a new section to a track.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a new application manager instance.

nodes.name: update
nodes.summary: Updates the manager state in response to an event.

nodes.name: resolve
nodes.summary: Resolves which strings and frets are involved in a chord or note passage.

nodes.name: get_frets
nodes.summary: Returns the frets for a given string and chord shape.

nodes.name: tab_host
nodes.summary: Creates a test plugin host for use in unit tests.
